description: TXN-STMT, the lock cause at each candidate position (the earlier lock probe blocked only the middle candidate). Candidates are rows 1, 20, 40 and 64, on separate data pages. Process a holds a pessimistic Edit on the first, the middle (40), the last (64) or all four candidates; process b runs UPDATE T SET V = V + 1 WHERE ID IN (1, 20, 40, 64) without options and then with dbFailOnError (Errors before and after, RecordsAffected), then reads the four rows; a cancels and closes. Finally a reads the rows after a 7 s pause and Idle. Asks whether a blocked candidate skips the whole statement, only itself, or fails with a surviving subset, by position and option.
